summary: Implemented Lambda (array.py, appended at end) and Lambdad (dictionary.py, after ConcatItemsd) with aliases LambdaD and LambdaDict appended after the ConcatItemsD alias line. Lambda asserts callable(func) with message "func must be callable" and calls func on the input unchanged. Lambdad calls the MapTransform base first, builds one internal Lambda, and applies it to each key on a shallow copy of the input. Dictionary module edits are limited to adding Callable to the typing import and Lambda to the array import list. Added Lambda and Lambdad entries to docs/source/transforms.rst in the specified sections. Added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py with identity and slicing cases (x[:, :, 10:, ::-2], non-empty). Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions; all verification was by reading the code.
